headline: HOW DO
THEY GET
PAID?

scenes.say: Your broker gets paid every time you trade. Guess how often they'll tell you to trade.
The principal-agent problem: the person acting for you has different goals than you.
You hand over the job. They know more than you. They're paid on something else, so they follow their incentive.
Nobody has to be evil. A pay structure pointing the wrong way is enough.
Brokers, fund managers, employees, even doctors can end up here.
Before taking advice, ask one thing: how does this person get paid?

takeaway: Before taking advice, ask one thing: how does this person get paid?
